idea: Particles spread from where they are crowded to where they are sparse, through the channels in a membrane, until both sides hold about the same number; only a pump, using energy, can push them the other way.

parameters.name: start
parameters.why: A small to a large crowd on the left, all within the kit's particle budget.

parameters.name: open
parameters.why: From shut channels, where nothing crosses, to fully open ones.

parameters.name: pump
parameters.why: No pump, up to a pump fast enough to beat diffusion.

moves: Particles wander on both sides of the membrane and slip through its channels, so the crowded side empties until both are about even; the pump carries particles across against the gradient.
steps: Particles spread from the crowded side
A pump works against the gradient
